notes: ① 更新改成「运行中静默安装」：面板点「更新到 x.y.z」不再先退出 DSH —— 宿主直接下载安装包、校验 sha256、备份旧版、覆盖插件目录，装好后点「重启 DSH」生效，写坏会自动用刚备的备份回滚。② 修好「检查不到更新」：清单改成候选源依次尝试（jsDelivr CDN 优先、GitHub raw 兜底），单次超时从 10 秒放宽到 30 秒 —— 原先国内直连 raw.githubusercontent.com 不通、Node 的 fetch 又不走系统代理，10 秒一到就被掐断，面板上只剩一句「This operation was aborted」。检查失败时会列出每个源各自的失败原因，面板还显示本次实际用的是哪个源。
notesEn: (1) Updates now install silently while DSH keeps running: clicking "Update to x.y.z" no longer exits DSH first — the host downloads the package, verifies sha256, backs up the old version and overwrites the plugin directory; click "Restart DSH" to apply, and a failed write rolls back from the backup it just made. (2) Fixed "cannot read the update manifest": the manifest is now tried against several sources in order (jsDelivr CDN first, GitHub raw as a fallback) with the per-request timeout raised from 10s to 30s — raw.githubusercontent.com is unreachable from some networks and Node's fetch ignores system proxies, so the request was aborted at 10s and the panel only showed "This operation was aborted". A failed check now lists the reason for each source, and the panel shows which source was actually used.
